_comment: Everything check-copy accepts that is NOT traceable to editable data. Every entry needs a reason. Policy (scripts/README.md): UI glyphs, the brand wordmark, composites assembled from several data strings, hidden anti-spam wording, and the text of developer-only noindex pages. Adding copy to code is not an acceptable exception - move it into src/_data and give the CMS a field instead. An entry that matches nothing is an error, so entries cannot outlive the text they excuse.

excludePages.reason: Internal social-card generator (noindex tool); not part of the public site.
Internal brand-ident animation tool (noindex); not part of the public site.
The Decap CMS shell (passthrough copy of cms/); editor tooling, not site copy.
Operations dashboard (passthrough copy of admin/); internal tool, not site copy.

entries.reason: The brand wordmark (logo link, og:site_name, schema.org organisation name). A proper name, not translatable copy; the SPEC exempts it together with the inline SVG logo.

The scroll-scrub hero plays 145 stills exported from the brand film (src/_includes/sections/hero.njk and scroll.njk point at /frames/desktop and /frames/mobile). They are a generated asset sequence, not a photo an editor picks; a developer re-exports them if the film changes.

The animated COVERED wordmark film in the closing banner (video and poster still). Same status as the inline SVG logo, which the SPEC exempts: a fixed brand asset, replaced by a developer when the identity changes. Its spoken description is the editable homepage cta videoLabel.
Decorative dot the stylesheet draws between ticker words (.marquee span::after). Pure ornament; the words themselves are editable.
Tick bullet the stylesheet draws before each list item (.list-card li::before). Pure ornament; the items are editable.
Arrow the stylesheet draws on buttons and 'wants' list items (.btn-primary::after, .list-card.wants li::before). Pure ornament; the labels are editable.
Large faint COVERED. watermark behind the closing banner (.cta-banner::before): the brand wordmark used as a background graphic, exempt like the logo.
Middle-dot glyph the compact footer template puts between its (editable) links on every page except the homepage - including pages editors add later. Punctuation between links, not words.
Pause icon on the venue-ticker button (the script swaps it with the play icon). Pure UI symbol; the button's spoken name is the editable homepage marquee pauseLabel.
Play icon the ticker script shows while the ticker is paused. Pure UI symbol; the button's spoken name is the editable homepage marquee pauseLabel.

Netlify spam-trap label inside

: the field is moved off-screen, hidden from assistive technology and unfocusable, so no visitor sees or hears it. Only bots read it, and it must keep reading like a normal field.
Hidden screen-reader sentence the marquee template builds from the intro, the (lower-cased) ticker words, the joiner word and the closing mark - all separate editable strings.
The footer prints the editable 'Last updated:' label and the editable date together in one line.

Developer demo page for the scroll-scrub component (robots noindex, excluded from collections and the sitemap, not linked from the site). Its explanatory copy lives in src/scroll.njk on purpose; move it into front matter if the page ever goes public.
